name: Chord stab
why: One chord hit short and hard, off the beat. The rhythm matters more than the notes.

ingredients.name: A sawtooth chord
ingredients.adds: Four notes at once, held for the whole step.

ingredients.name: Stab it
ingredients.adds: The chord is cut off almost as soon as it starts.

knobs.below: A click with no chord in it.

ingredients.name: Filter snap
ingredients.adds: Each stab starts bright and closes at once.
ingredients.listenFor: A hard front edge on every hit.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: Buzzy and thin; it fights the hats.

knobs.label: snap time
knobs.above: The snap turns into a slow "wow".

ingredients.name: Echo
ingredients.adds: Repeats that land between the hits.
ingredients.listenFor: The stabs seem to answer themselves.

knobs.above: You can't tell hits from echoes.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.below: Dry and stuck to the speaker.

pitfalls: A stab on every beat lands on the kick and loses its bounce.
